Class FactoryBase

java.lang.Object
org.apache.naming.factory.FactoryBase
All Implemented Interfaces:
ObjectFactory
Direct Known Subclasses:
EjbFactory, ResourceEnvFactory, ResourceFactory, TransactionFactory
public abstract class FactoryBase extends Object implements ObjectFactory
Abstract base class that provides common functionality required by subclasses. This class exists primarily to reduce code duplication.
